{"reason":"Add a market-signal-mismatch fallback for demand-forecast-error and lower the bias cutoff from 0.1 to 0.05. This fixes the listed unknown rows with market-mismatch=#t and biases 0.065–0.081, retains supplier-delay precedence, and should improve accuracy above 0.708 and recovery above 3,161,000.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
